translation: 先前的，前者的；以前的，从前的
original_sentence: A former UN official once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.”
readingExamples: A former UN official once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.”
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having a particular position in the past, but not now; previous
(2) adj. happening or existing before, but not now; earlier
(3) det./pron. (the former) the first of two people or things just mentioned

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （the former）前者（相对于 the latter 后者）
uncommonMeanings.example: She was torn between honesty and comfort, and in the end chose the former, telling the painful truth even though it cost her a friendship. （读后续写·抉择·前者）

posExamples.sentence: Standing before the crumbling walls of his former school, the old man felt a wave of memories wash over him, and for a moment he was a barefoot boy again. （读后续写·故地重游·回忆）
As a former volunteer of our reading club, I am writing to share how deeply this experience shaped the person I have become. （应用文·分享信）
A former UN official once said, 'Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.' （议论文·引用权威）
When forced to choose between fame and freedom, the wise artist abandoned the former, for no applause could ever be worth the loss of her own soul. （议论文·价值取舍·前者）

collocations.example: The former champion returned to the court, not to win medals, but to coach the very children who once cheered for him. （读后续写·传承）
After months of illness, he was but a shadow of his former self, yet his eyes still burned with the old determination. （读后续写·人物·今昔对比）
In former times, this quiet river was so polluted that not a single fish could survive in its waters. （议论文·今昔对比·环保）
By chance she ran into a former classmate at the railway station, and the years seemed to melt away in an instant. （读后续写·重逢）
Two roads lay before him — one safe, one full of risk; the former promised comfort, the latter, growth. （议论文·抉择）
Returning to his former home after twenty years abroad, he was moved to tears by how little the old lane had changed. （读后续写·思乡）
The volunteers were determined to restore the ancient temple to its former glory. （应用文·文化保护）

synonyms.translation: 后者(与 the former 前者相对)
synonyms.example: Two roads lay before him — one safe, one full of risk; the former promised comfort, the latter, growth. （议论文·抉择·the former...the latter...）
synonyms.usage: 对应关系(须成对记): the former 前者 ↔ the latter 后者; former adj.以前的,前任的 ↔ latter adj.后者的,后面的。former 与 latter 一前一后,常用于二选一或先后对比的论证。

synonyms.example: Unlike her previous attempts, this time she prepared for weeks, and her confidence showed in every word. （读后续写·成长）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:previous 侧重紧挨着当前之前的那一次/那个,可修饰次数、经历;former 侧重曾经担任某职、拥有某身份而如今不再,常修饰头衔身份

synonyms.example: Learning from past mistakes, the team approached the new project with far greater caution. （议论文·经验）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:past 泛指过去的、逝去的,较口语通用;former 更正式,强调'曾经是而现在不是'的身份转变,或用于 the former/the latter 结构

synonyms.example: His ex-teacher still kept every essay he had ever handed in, tucked away in a wooden drawer. （读后续写·师恩）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:ex- 是构词前缀(ex-teacher, ex-wife),口语色彩强,多指人际关系上的前任;former 更书面正式,适用范围更广,可修饰事物

advancedExpressions.expression: a mere shadow of one's former self
advancedExpressions.example: The proud oak that had once shaded the whole yard was now a mere shadow of its former self, yet still it clung stubbornly to life. （用今昔对比+拟人烘托坚韧主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: as a former ..., I feel obliged to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a former member of the environmental club, I feel obliged to share a few lessons that may guide those who follow in our footsteps. （用旧身份增强建议的说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: of the two, the former ... whereas the latter ...
advancedExpressions.example: Of the two paths, the former offers safety and certainty, whereas the latter demands courage but promises genuine growth. （former/latter 平行结构使对比清晰有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He visited his former school.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Drawn back by a longing he could not name, he returned to his former school, where every worn desk and faded blackboard whispered of the dreams he had once dared to dream. （读后续写·故地重游·抒情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语 Drawn back by a longing 开头 + where 引导非限定定语从句 + 拟人 whispered of + 同源修辞 dreams he had once dared to dream

sentenceUpgrade.original: The former plan was better than the new one.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Weighing the two proposals side by side, the committee concluded that the former, though less ambitious, rested on a far firmer foundation than its dazzling but reckless successor. （议论文·方案比较·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语 Weighing...side by side + the former 指代前者 + though 让步插入 + 对比形容词 dazzling but reckless 修饰后者

classPractice.question: Their farm has been reduced to half ____ ____ ____ (以前的一半大小).
classPractice.note: PPT原题。former adj.以前的；be reduced to half its former size 缩小到原来的一半。

classPractice.question: Of swimming and football he prefers ____ ____ (前者).
classPractice.note: PPT原题。the former 前者，与 the latter 后者相对；两者中取一时使用。

classPractice.question: 这座美丽的老建筑已恢复了昔日的辉煌。This beautiful old building has been restored to ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: PPT例句：former glory 昔日的辉煌；restore ... to its former glory 使……恢复昔日荣光。

classPractice.question: The country was ____ (former) known as Burma.
classPractice.note: 词形变化：former adj.→formerly adv.以前、从前；修饰过去分词 known 用副词。

translation: n. 官员，要员 | adj. 官方的，正式的，公务的
original_sentence: A former UN official once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.”
readingExamples: A former UN official once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.”
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person who holds a position of authority in an organization or government
(2) adj. relating to a position of authority, and the duties and rights connected with it
(3) adj. approved of or done by someone in authority; formally recognized
(4) adj. said or announced publicly, but perhaps not completely true

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 1. 官员，高级职员：a government official 政府官员（课文词块：a former UN official 一位联合国前官员）
uncommonMeanings.example: A former UN official once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.” （课文原句）一位联合国前官员曾说：“拯救我们的星球、让人们摆脱贫困、促进经济增长……这些是同一场战斗。”

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 2. 官方的，正式的：official language 官方语言 / an official statement 官方声明
uncommonMeanings.example: English is one of the official languages of the United Nations. 英语是联合国的官方语言之一。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 3. 官方对外声称的（言外之意未必是真相）
uncommonMeanings.example: The official reason for his sudden departure was 'health issues', but the knowing glances around the office told a very different story. （读后续写·悬疑·表里不一）

posExamples.sentence: A weary official stepped out of the town hall at midnight, having spent hours listening to villagers pour out their worries about the flooded fields. （读后续写·亲民官员·画面）
We are delighted to announce that the school has received official permission to hold the charity fair in the central square this Saturday. （应用文·通知）
A former UN official once said, 'Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.' （议论文·引用权威）
Once the results became official, cheers erupted across the classroom, and even the shyest student could not hold back a triumphant grin. （读后续写·放榜·喜悦）

wordForms.noun: official (官员) / office (办公室；官职：take office 就职 / in office 在任) / officialdom (官场)
wordForms.adjective: official (官方的，正式的) / unofficial (非官方的)
wordForms.other: 词族链：office 职务 → official 官员；官方的 → officially 正式地；注意 officer（军官/警官）与 official（文职官员）拼写形近、含义不同

collocations.example: A local official visited our school to hear students' suggestions on how to make the town greener. （应用文·活动报道）
The committee promised to release an official statement as soon as the investigation was complete. （应用文·通知）
Without official approval, the ambitious clean-up project could never have got off the ground. （议论文·制度保障）
During the delegation's official visit, students were given a rare chance to showcase their science projects. （应用文·报道）
All the latest updates about the competition will be posted on the school's official website. （应用文·通知）
The moment the headmaster signed the certificate, her role as club president was made official. （读后续写·仪式感）
In his official capacity as class monitor, he was responsible for reporting any safety concerns to the teacher. （应用文·职责说明）

synonyms.example: The kind police officer walked the lost child all the way home, holding her tiny hand the entire way. （读后续写·温情）
synonyms.usage: 重点辨析：official 指政府部门/机构中的'文职官员'（a government official 政府官员 / a UN official 联合国官员）；officer 指'军官、警官、高级船员'等穿制服、有职衔的执勤人员（a police officer 警官 / an army officer 军官）；不能用 official 称呼警察，也不用 officer 泛指政府文职官员

synonyms.example: A formal apology was expected, yet what moved everyone was the sincerity behind his simple words. （读后续写·道歉）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:作形容词时 formal 侧重'合乎礼节、正规的'(formal dress/apology);official 侧重'官方的、经权威认可的'(official approval),二者语义不同,勿混用

synonyms.translation: 当局，权威机构（常用复数）
synonyms.example: The local authorities acted swiftly to reopen the flooded road within a single day. （议论文·治理效率）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:authorities(复数)指有权管理的机构/当局(集体);official 指具体的某位官员(个人),一个是机构一个是人

advancedExpressions.expression: behind the official ..., there lay ...
advancedExpressions.example: Behind the official calm of his announcement, there lay a storm of doubt that only his trembling hands betrayed. （表里反差+细节 trembling hands 泄露真实情绪）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are pleased to make it official that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are pleased to make it official that our school has been named the greenest campus in the district this year. （通知/喜报中正式宣布好消息）

advancedExpressions.expression: as a leading official once put it, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a leading official once put it, protecting our planet and lifting people out of poverty are 'one and the same fight'. （引用权威人士话语增强论点说服力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: An official came to help the villagers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rolling up his sleeves and wading into the muddy floodwater, the young official worked shoulder to shoulder with the villagers, proving that real authority lies not in a title but in service. （读后续写·亲民干部·画面+升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语连用 Rolling up...and wading into... + 动作画面 shoulder to shoulder + proving that 分词结果 + not...but 对比点题

sentenceUpgrade.original: The government made the plan official.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: After months of heated debate, the authorities at last made the ambitious green plan official, thereby turning a fragile hope into a binding commitment for the whole city. （议论文·环保政策·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语 After months of...debate 开头 + make sth official 固定表达 + thereby 分词状语接结果 + 抽象对比 fragile hope→binding commitment

classPractice.question: A ____ UN ____ (一位联合国前官员) once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.”
classPractice.note: 课文原句：a former UN official 一位联合国前官员；official 此处作名词'官员'。

classPractice.question: The winners of the competition will be ____ (official) announced on the school's official website.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 announced 用副词 officially 正式地、官方地；对比 the official website 官方网站（adj.）。

classPractice.question: A senior government ____ (official / officer) was sent to inspect the flooded area, and a police ____ helped direct the traffic.
classPractice.note: official 泛指政府或机构中有职权的官员；officer 多指警官、军官等有明确职衔的执勤人员（police officer 警察）。

original_sentence: A former UN official once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.”
readingExamples: A former UN official once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.”
definitionEn:
(1) n. the state of being extremely poor and lacking the money to meet basic needs
(2) n. the condition of lacking something, or of being present only in small amounts
(3) n. (poverty of) a lack of a particular quality; poorness in quality

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （品质、思想等的）贫乏，匮乏
uncommonMeanings.example: It was not a poverty of money but a poverty of imagination that kept the old firm from ever daring to change. （议论文·思想匮乏·批判）

posExamples.sentence: Though raised in bitter poverty, the girl never let the empty cupboards dim the light in her eyes or the dream of college in her heart. （读后续写·寒门励志·画面）
I am writing to invite you to join our charity sale, whose sole purpose is to help lift children in remote areas out of poverty through the gift of education. （应用文·邀请信·公益）
Poverty is not merely a shortage of money; it robs people of dignity, opportunity and, most cruelly, the hope of a better tomorrow. （议论文·社会问题·递进论证）
A former UN official once said that saving our planet and lifting people out of poverty are 'one and the same fight'. （议论文·引用·扶贫与环保）

wordForms.adjective: poor（贫穷的；差的）; impoverished（赤贫的，正式）
wordForms.adverb: poorly（贫穷地；差劲地：a poorly paid job 低薪工作）
wordForms.other: impoverish (vt. 使贫困)；小贴士：poverty 为抽象不可数名词，不加冠词——live in poverty；“穷人”用 the poor（the+形容词表一类人，谓语用复数）

collocations.phrase: lift / raise people out of poverty
collocations.translation: 使人们摆脱贫困（课文原句词块：lifting people out of poverty）
collocations.example: A former UN official once said, “Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth ... these are one and the same fight.” 一位前联合国官员曾说：“拯救地球、让人们摆脱贫困、推动经济增长……这是同一场战斗。”（课文原句）/ Education, more than any handout, is the surest way to lift a whole generation out of poverty. （议论文·扶贫）

collocations.translation: 生活贫困（反义：live in plenty / comfort 生活富足）
collocations.example: For years the family lived in poverty, yet their tiny home was always warm with laughter and love. （读后续写·贫而温馨）

collocations.translation: 贫困线（above / below the poverty line 在贫困线以上 / 以下）
collocations.example: Thanks to years of collective effort, millions of rural residents have been raised above the poverty line. （议论文·成就）
Volunteers from across the country united to combat poverty in the mountainous villages. （应用文·公益报道）
The photographs of children in abject poverty moved the whole audience to tears and to action. （读后续写·触动）
Determined to escape poverty, she studied by candlelight long after the whole village had fallen asleep. （读后续写·奋斗）
Only by giving children access to schools can we hope to break the cycle of poverty for good. （议论文·根本对策）
Our country's remarkable achievements in poverty alleviation have inspired the whole world. （议论文·成就）

synonyms.example: The poor are often hit hardest by rising prices. 穷人常常受物价上涨的打击最重。
synonyms.usage: 用法对照：poverty 是抽象名词，指“贫穷”这一状态或现象（fight poverty 与贫困作斗争 / out of poverty 摆脱贫困）；the poor 是“the+形容词”表一类人，= poor people，作主语时谓语用复数：The poor are ...；不能说 the poverty people

synonyms.example: The hardship of those early years, far from crushing him, forged a spirit as tough as steel. （读后续写·磨砺）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:hardship 泛指各种艰难困苦(可含贫穷、疾病、劳累等),范围广;poverty 特指经济上的贫穷、缺钱,聚焦物质匮乏

synonyms.translation: 贫困，匮乏（正式，常用 in need）
synonyms.example: The donation drive aims to bring warmth to families in need this winter. （应用文·公益）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:need 作名词指'贫困、急需'时较委婉正式,常见于 in need(处于困境的),语气比 poverty 温和;poverty 更直接、程度更重

synonyms.example: Years of deprivation had taught the villagers to treasure even the smallest kindness. （读后续写·感恩）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:deprivation 强调被剥夺了本应享有的基本条件(食物、教育、机会等),书面正式;poverty 侧重贫穷这一整体状态,较通用

advancedExpressions.expression: poverty could bend sb.'s back but never break sb.'s spirit
advancedExpressions.example: Poverty could bend her back with endless labour, but it could never break the quiet dignity that shone in her weathered face. （用 bend...but never break 对照升华人物精神）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us join hands to drive poverty from ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us join hands to drive poverty from every corner of these mountain villages, for no child should be denied a future merely by the accident of birth. （倡议信+ for 引导理由升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: the true cure for poverty lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The true cure for poverty lies not in temporary handouts but in the lasting empowerment that only education can provide. （not...but 对比+抽象概念 empowerment 提升论证深度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The family was very poor.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Poverty pressed upon the family like a long, unyielding winter, yet within those bare walls burned a warmth that no cold could ever put out. （读后续写·寒门·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人 Poverty pressed upon + 明喻 like a long, unyielding winter + yet 转折 + 冷暖意象对照 cold vs. warmth 点亮希望

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should help poor people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is the shared duty of every one of us to reach out to those trapped in poverty, offering not merely food and money, but the education and dignity that can transform their lives for good. （议论文·扶贫·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is the shared duty of...to... 强调句式 + reach out to 短语 + those trapped in poverty 定语 + not merely...but 递进 + 三名词并列 education and dignity

classPractice.question: 拯救地球、让人们摆脱贫困、实现经济增长——这是同一场战斗。Saving our planet, ____ people ____ ____ poverty, advancing economic growth — these are one and the same fight.
classPractice.note: 课文原句（前联合国官员名言）；lift sb out of poverty 使某人摆脱贫困

classPractice.question: Many families in remote areas are still living ____ poverty.
classPractice.note: live in poverty 生活贫困；反义 live in plenty/comfort

classPractice.question: ____ (poor) is not a barrier to success as long as you keep working hard.
classPractice.note: poor adj. 贫穷的 → poverty n. 贫穷（不可数）；作主语用名词

translation: vt. 毒死，毒害 | n. 毒药，毒素
original_sentence: Large amounts of industrial waste poison the water after they enter water bodies.
readingExamples: Large amounts of industrial waste poison the water after they enter water bodies.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a substance that can cause death or serious harm if it is swallowed, breathed in, or absorbed by a living thing
(2) vt. to give a person or animal poison, especially in order to kill them
(3) vt. to make land, water, or air dangerously dirty by adding harmful substances
(4) vt. to have a very harmful or destructive effect on someone's mind, feelings, or a relationship

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ① 毒药，毒物（最基本义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The bottle was clearly labelled "Poison". 瓶子上清楚地标着“毒药”。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ② 毒害，下毒；污染（水/土壤/空气）
uncommonMeanings.example: Large amounts of industrial waste poison the water after they enter water bodies. 大量工业废物进入水体后会毒害水质。（课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③ 毒化，败坏（气氛、关系、思想）【熟词僻义】
uncommonMeanings.example: The rumour poisoned the atmosphere of trust in the team. 谣言毒化了团队的信任氛围。/ One careless rumour was enough to poison the friendship they had spent ten years building. （读后续写·友情破裂）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 毒害心灵的事物;败坏道德的影响
uncommonMeanings.example: Little by little, the constant flattery worked on him like a slow poison, until the humble boy she once knew had vanished entirely. （读后续写·人物堕落·比喻）

posExamples.sentence: The old fox lay motionless by the stream, its glassy eyes fixed on nothing — the pellets scattered nearby told me at once that a neighbouring farmer had poisoned it to protect his hens. （读后续写·乡村·动物之死）
I am writing to warn residents that the untreated sewage flowing into our river is quietly poisoning the very water on which thousands of families depend for their daily lives. （应用文·倡议书）
Once regarded as harmless, plastic waste has proved to be a slow poison to marine life, since countless creatures mistake it for food and perish. （议论文·环境保护）
History reminds us that unchecked prejudice can poison an entire generation's mind, turning neighbours into strangers and reason into blind hatred. （议论文·社会观点）

wordForms.noun: poison（毒药，毒物）; poisoning（中毒：food poisoning 食物中毒）
wordForms.adjective: poisonous（有毒的：poisonous chemicals 有毒化学品，课文词块）
wordForms.other: 词形链：poison(n./v.)→poisonous(adj.)→poisoning(n.)；小贴士：poisonous 指本身有毒（a poisonous snake 毒蛇），poisoned 指被下了毒（a poisoned apple 被下毒的苹果）

idioms.idiom: one man's meat is another man's poison
idioms.translation: 甲之蜜糖,乙之砒霜(萝卜青菜各有所爱)
idioms.example: She could not understand why I loved the quiet of the countryside, but as the saying goes, one man's meat is another man's poison. （读后续写·观念差异）
By spreading half-truths before the meeting, he had already poisoned the well against the new proposal. （议论文·舆论操纵）

collocations.example: The vet warned us that the puppy had somehow swallowed rat poison and needed treatment within the hour. （读后续写·宠物危机）
In the old legend, a single drop of the deadly poison was said to be enough to fell a fully grown horse. （读后续写·传说）
Rather than surrender the fortress, the ancient general chose to take poison, a decision remembered for centuries. （读后续写·历史场景）

collocations.translation: 毒害某人的思想;挑拨某人反对
collocations.example: The stepmother slowly poisoned the boy's mind against his own gentle father. （读后续写·家庭矛盾）
Half the campers came down with food poisoning after the picnic, and the trip was cut short. （读后续写·意外插曲）
His constant sarcasm poisoned the atmosphere of the whole office within a matter of weeks. （议论文·人际关系）

collocations.translation: 污染水 / 土壤 / 空气
collocations.example: For decades the abandoned factory had poisoned the soil, and nothing green would grow within a mile of it. （读后续写·环境）

collocations.translation: 看似诱人实则有害之物;烫手山芋
collocations.example: The promotion turned out to be a poisoned chalice, bringing him endless stress and few real rewards. （议论文·职场反思）

synonyms.example: Chemical runoff had contaminated the reservoir, and the town was ordered to boil all its water. （应用文·公告）
synonyms.usage: 偏中性、科学化,强调使某物混入有害物质而变脏,多用于水、食物、土壤;poison 语气更重,含'致命/毒害'意味

synonyms.example: Absolute power, unchecked by law, will inevitably corrupt even the most honest of leaders. （议论文·权力）
synonyms.usage: 侧重道德、品格的败坏;poison 作比喻义时与之相近,但 poison 更强调'从内部慢慢毒害'的画面感

synonyms.example: A single scandal was enough to taint a reputation he had guarded all his life. （议论文·声誉）
synonyms.usage: 多指名誉、纯洁被沾染的抽象损害,程度较 poison 轻,书面语色彩强

advancedExpressions.expression: like a slow poison, sth. crept through ...
advancedExpressions.example: Like a slow poison, the doubt crept through her heart, until even her dearest memories seemed suddenly suspect. （明喻+拟人,续写刻画心理侵蚀）

advancedExpressions.expression: if we allow ... to poison ..., ... will pay the price
advancedExpressions.example: If we allow industrial waste to poison our rivers unchecked, it is our own children who will one day pay the price. （倡议信警示句,条件句+反问式责任归因）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being harmless, ... acts as a poison that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being harmless, unchecked online rumour acts as a poison that erodes public trust drop by drop. （让步铺垫+比喻延伸,加强论证力度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The waste poisoned the river.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Where the factory's murky discharge met the current, the river seemed to sicken before our eyes — its once-silver surface dulling to a lifeless grey, its fish drifting belly-up, poisoned by a stream of waste no one had thought to question. （读后续写·环境+画面描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: where 引导地点状语从句设景 + 破折号补充画面 + 感官细节(silver→grey, belly-up)+ 过去分词短语 poisoned by... 作状语

sentenceUpgrade.original: Pollution poisons water and harms people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It cannot be denied that industrial pollution does more than merely dirty our water; it slowly poisons the very source of life, inflicting a lasting toll on the health of generations yet unborn. （议论文·环境保护）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It cannot be denied that... 强调句式 + does more than merely 递进否定 + the very source of life 强调 + generations yet unborn 提升立意高度

classPractice.question: Water pollution is also caused by ____ (poison) chemicals used in agriculture.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 chemicals 需用形容词 poisonous"有毒的"；词形链：poison(n./v.)→poisonous(adj.)。本句为教材 Project 板块原句。

classPractice.question: Half the campers came down with food ____ (poison) after the picnic, and the trip had to be cut short.
classPractice.note: food poisoning"食物中毒"为固定搭配，用 poisoning 这一名词形式。

classPractice.question: 大量工业废物进入水体后会毒害水质。（用 poison 作动词）
classPractice.answer: Large amounts of industrial waste poison the water after they enter water bodies.
classPractice.note: poison 作及物动词"毒害，污染(水/土壤/空气)"；教材原句，注意主语 large amounts of... 谓语用复数。

translation: n. 化学制品 | adj. 化学的，化学作用的
original_sentence: Water pollution is also caused by poisonous chemicals used in agriculture.
readingExamples: Water pollution is also caused by poisonous chemicals used in agriculture.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a substance used in or produced by a reaction involving changes to atoms or molecules, especially one made or used in industry or science
(2) adj. relating to chemistry, or to the changes that happen when substances combine or react with one another
(3) adj. involving or produced by the use of chemicals, especially artificial ones (as opposed to natural)

posExamples.sentence: As I lifted the lid of the abandoned drum, a sharp, biting smell of chemicals stung my nose, and I stumbled backward, suddenly aware that this quiet warehouse hid a secret far more dangerous than I had imagined. （读后续写·悬疑·探险）
I am writing to urge our school to reduce its use of chemical fertilisers on the sports field, as they wash into the nearby pond and threaten the frogs we all love to watch. （应用文·建议信）
Although modern agriculture relies heavily on chemicals to boost output, an over-dependence on them may, in the long run, exhaust the soil and endanger our health. （议论文·农业与健康）
The teacher's simple experiment showed that a chemical reaction can transform two colourless liquids into a startling blue in a single heartbeat, and the whole class gasped in wonder. （读后续写·课堂·惊奇）

wordForms.noun: chemical（化学品，常用复数 chemicals）; chemistry（化学〈学科〉）; chemist（化学家；〈英〉药剂师，the chemist's 药店）
wordForms.adjective: chemical（化学的：chemical reaction 化学反应）
wordForms.other: 词形三兄弟：chemistry 学科“化学”/ chemical adj.“化学的”兼 n.“化学品”/ chemist 人“化学家；药剂师”；小贴士：英式 the chemist's = 美式 drugstore 药店

collocations.translation: 农业上使用的有毒化学品（课文原句词块；chemical 作名词“化学品”常用复数）
collocations.example: Water pollution is also caused by poisonous chemicals used in agriculture. 水污染也由农业上使用的有毒化学品造成。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 化学反应（chemical 作形容词“化学的”）
collocations.example: A gentle warmth spread through the flask as the chemical reaction quietly began. （读后续写·实验）
The report revealed that toxic chemicals from the tannery had been seeping into the groundwater for years. （应用文·调查报告）
Many farmers are now turning away from chemical pesticides in favour of natural methods. （议论文·可持续农业）
The city's booming chemical industry brought jobs, but also a haze that never quite lifted. （议论文·发展与代价）
Strict rules govern how hazardous chemicals must be stored and labelled. （应用文·安全须知）
Untreated chemical waste is one of the leading causes of river pollution worldwide. （议论文·环境）
The plant had illegally released chemicals into the bay under cover of darkness. （读后续写·揭发）
Scientists analysed the water's chemical composition to trace the source of the contamination. （应用文·实验报告）

synonyms.example: The mysterious white substance turned out to be nothing more dangerous than powdered sugar. （读后续写·误会）
synonyms.usage: 泛指任何物质,范围最广、最中性;chemical 特指人工制造或化学反应中的物质,常带工业/科学色彩

synonyms.example: Water is a compound formed from hydrogen and oxygen. （说明文·科普）
synonyms.usage: 化学术语,指由两种及以上元素结合成的物质,概念比 chemical 精确;chemical 更口语、更常用

synonyms.example: Factories must install filters to trap pollutants before releasing smoke into the air. （议论文·环保）
synonyms.usage: 特指造成污染的有害物质,含明显负面义;chemical 本身中性,加 toxic/harmful 才含贬义

advancedExpressions.expression: the sharp smell of chemicals + 动作反应
advancedExpressions.example: The sharp smell of chemicals hit me the instant the door swung open, and my stomach tightened with a nameless dread. （感官(嗅觉)引出心理反应,续写渲染紧张气氛）

advancedExpressions.expression: by replacing chemical ... with ..., we can ...
advancedExpressions.example: By replacing chemical fertilisers with organic compost, we can protect both our soil and the little pond that our whole community treasures. （建议信'替换方案+双重收益'句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: chemicals are a double-edged sword: while ..., they ...
advancedExpressions.example: Chemicals are a double-edged sword: while they have doubled our harvests and cured our diseases, they have also, if misused, poisoned the very earth that feeds us. （双刃剑句式,while 让步平衡论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The water was polluted by chemicals from the factory.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By the time we reached the lower reaches of the stream, the crystal water of the mountains had given way to a sluggish, foaming brown, tainted by the chemicals that the factory upstream poured out day and night. （读后续写·环境对比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: By the time... 时间状语从句设进程 + give way to 表转变 + 颜色/质感对比(crystal→foaming brown)+ tainted by... 过去分词短语作后置定语

sentenceUpgrade.original: We use too many chemicals in farming.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time that we reconsidered our blind reliance on chemicals in farming, for the short-term gain of a richer harvest may well come at the long-term cost of a barren land. （议论文·呼吁反思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time that + 虚拟语气(reconsidered)呼吁 + for 引导原因 + short-term gain...long-term cost 对比 + come at the cost of 固定表达

classPractice.question: Water pollution is also caused by poisonous ____ (chemical) used in agriculture.
classPractice.note: chemical 作可数名词"化学品"，此处泛指农用化学品，用复数 chemicals。教材原句。

classPractice.question: She has been fascinated by ____ (chemical) since she watched her first experiment, and now she plans to study it at university.
classPractice.note: 学科"化学"是 chemistry；注意词形区分：chemistry(化学)/chemical(化学的；化学品)/chemist(化学家；药剂师)。

classPractice.question: 许多农民如今正弃用化学农药，转而采用自然方法。Many farmers are now turning away from ____ ____ (化学农药) in favour of natural methods.
classPractice.note: chemical 作形容词"化学的"；chemical pesticides / chemical fertilisers(化学农药/化肥)为高考常考搭配。

original_sentence: Polluted water bodies not only do harm to animals and plants; they also have a long-lasting effect on humans.
readingExamples: Polluted water bodies not only do harm to animals and plants; they also have a long-lasting effect on humans.
definitionEn:
(1) n. something that happens or follows as a result of a particular action, decision, or situation (often a bad one)
(2) n. (formal) importance or significance, especially in a phrase such as 'of consequence' or 'of no consequence'
(3) n. (in the plural, in the phrase 'take the consequences') the results that you must accept as a punishment for your actions

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 重要性,重大意义(常用于 of (great/little/no) consequence)
uncommonMeanings.example: To the busy adults, the old man's rambling stories seemed of little consequence; but to the wide-eyed boy at his knee, they were the very keys to the world. （读后续写·祖孙·被忽视的珍贵）

posExamples.sentence: As the flames leapt higher, I finally grasped the terrible consequence of my carelessness: the single match I had tossed aside had set the whole dry hillside ablaze. （读后续写·后悔·灾难）
I am writing to remind every member that leaving litter behind after our hikes has serious consequences for the wildlife that call these mountains home. （应用文·倡议书）
Every choice we make, however small, carries its own consequences; therefore, wisdom lies not in avoiding decisions but in weighing them with care. （议论文·选择与责任）
Cutting down the ancient forest may bring quick profit, but the environmental consequences — soil erosion, vanished species, a warming climate — will haunt us for generations. （议论文·环境保护）

wordForms.adjective: consequent（随之发生的）; consequential（作为结果的；重要的）
wordForms.adverb: consequently（因此，所以 = as a result，书面衔接词）
wordForms.other: consequently 常置于分号后或句首作因果衔接：The river was polluted; consequently, the fish died. 河水被污染了，因此鱼都死了。

idioms.example: He had ignored every warning, and in consequence found himself utterly alone when the storm finally broke. （读后续写·因果·孤立无援）
You are free to make your own choices, but you must also be prepared to face the consequences. （议论文·责任）
What others thought of her clothes was, in that shining moment on stage, of no consequence whatsoever. （读后续写·自信绽放）

collocations.translation: 对……有长期影响（课文原句词块；≈ have long-lasting consequences for）
collocations.example: Polluted water bodies not only do harm to animals and plants; they also have a long-lasting effect on humans. 被污染的水体不仅危害动植物，对人类也有长期影响。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 作为……的结果，由于（= as a result of）
collocations.example: As a consequence of the heavy rains, the once-gentle river had swollen into a raging torrent overnight. （读后续写·自然灾害）

collocations.translation: 面对 / 承担后果（the 不可省）
collocations.example: Those who pollute the sea for profit should be the ones to bear the consequences. （议论文·公平）
Ignoring the doctor's advice could have serious consequences for your recovery. （应用文·健康提醒）
The decision to build the dam had far-reaching consequences for every village downstream. （议论文·发展代价）
A moment of anger can leave far-reaching consequences that no apology will ever fully undo. （读后续写·冲动之悔）
Well-meant charity can sometimes bring unintended consequences, weakening the very people it hopes to help. （议论文·辩证思考）
Growing up, he learned the hard way to think about the consequences of his actions before he acted. （读后续写·成长）
The captain ignored the warning lights, with disastrous consequences for the entire crew. （读后续写·灾难）

synonyms.example: As a result of years of hard training, she stood at last on the Olympic podium. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 最普通、最中性,好坏结果均可;consequence 常暗示较严重或不好的、需承担的后果,语气更重、更正式

synonyms.example: No one could predict the outcome of the fierce debate until the very last vote was counted. （议论文·不确定性）
synonyms.usage: 指整个过程最终的结果或结局,中性,常用于比赛、谈判、事件;consequence 强调因果链中'由某行为引出'的后续影响

synonyms.example: In the aftermath of the flood, neighbours who had never spoken now worked side by side to rebuild. （读后续写·灾后重建）
synonyms.usage: 特指灾难、战争、事故之后的一段时期及其影响,画面感强、色彩沉重;consequence 更抽象、适用面更广

advancedExpressions.expression: not only ...; (they) also ...（不倒装） vs. Not only + 助动词 + 主语 ...（句首须倒装）
advancedExpressions.example: 课文长句：Polluted water bodies not only do harm to animals and plants; they also have a long-lasting effect on humans. 分析：分号连接两个并列分句；not only 位于主语 (Polluted water bodies) 之后，不倒装，第二分句用 they also 呼应。对比：not only 置于句首时须部分倒装——Not only do polluted water bodies harm animals and plants, but they also affect humans.

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. grasp the consequence of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did I grasp the full consequence of my silence — that a single word, had I dared to speak it, might have changed everything. （倒装+虚拟语气 had I..., 续写强化懊悔）

advancedExpressions.expression: if we fail to ..., the consequences will be ...
advancedExpressions.example: If we fail to act now, the consequences of our indifference will fall not on us, but on the children who inherit this wounded planet. （倡议信条件句+责任转移,增强号召力）

advancedExpressions.expression: every ... carries consequences; the question is not whether ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: Every technological leap carries consequences; the question is not whether we should embrace progress, but whether we are wise enough to foresee its price. （设问句式深化论点,并列 whether 结构）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He realized the consequence of what he had done.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Standing amid the wreckage, he realized at last the full consequence of what he had done — and the realization settled over him like a cold, heavy fog from which there seemed no escape. （读后续写·悔悟+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词短语(Standing amid...)开头设景 + at last / full 强化程度 + 破折号补充 + 比喻(like a cold fog)+ from which 定语从句延伸心理

sentenceUpgrade.original: If we pollute the water, there will be bad results for people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Should we continue to pollute our rivers so recklessly, the consequences will be neither distant nor trivial: contaminated crops, failing health, and a legacy of ruin passed silently down to those who follow us. （议论文·环境警示）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Should 引导倒装虚拟条件句 + neither...nor 强调 + 冒号引出三项后果排比 + a legacy of ruin 提升立意 + those who follow us 面向未来收束

classPractice.question: 由于连日暴雨，原本平缓的河水一夜之间暴涨成激流。（每空一词，用 consequence 的短语）____ ____ ____ ____ the heavy rains, the once-gentle river swelled into a raging torrent overnight.
classPractice.note: as a consequence (of) = as a result (of)"由于，作为……的结果"；of 后接原因。

classPractice.question: Ignoring the doctor's advice could have serious ____ (consequence) for your recovery.
classPractice.note: have serious/grave consequences (for...)"(对……)造成严重后果"，consequence 表"后果"常用复数。

classPractice.question: 你可以自己做选择，但也必须准备好承担后果。You are free to make your own choices, but you must also be prepared to ____ ____ ____ (承担后果).
classPractice.answer: face the consequences / take the consequences / bear the consequences / suffer the consequences
classPractice.note: face/take/bear/suffer the consequences"承担后果"，四个动词均可，注意 the 不可省。

original_sentence: For example, in many parts of the world, the poor quality of the local drinking water gives rise to public health problems.
readingExamples: For example, in many parts of the world, the poor quality of the local drinking water gives rise to public health problems.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to cause something to happen or exist, especially a problem, feeling, or situation (usually something unwelcome)
(2) phr. to be the origin or source from which something develops

posExamples.sentence: The sudden silence in the old house gave rise to a strange unease in me, as if the very walls were holding their breath, waiting for something to happen. （读后续写·悬疑·氛围）
I am writing to point out that the lack of dustbins along the riverside path has given rise to a growing litter problem that spoils the view for everyone. （应用文·投诉/建议信）
The uneven distribution of clean water across the globe has given rise to conflicts, migrations, and public health crises that no single nation can solve alone. （议论文·全球问题）
Her kind, patient smile gave rise to a warmth in the frightened child's heart, and slowly, hesitantly, he reached out to take her hand. （读后续写·温情·情感转变）

collocations.phrase: the poor quality of ... gives rise to ...
collocations.translation: ……质量差引发……（课文原句；主谓一致小贴士：主语中心词 quality 为单数，谓语用 gives，不受 of the local drinking water 干扰）
collocations.example: For example, in many parts of the world, the poor quality of the local drinking water gives rise to public health problems. 例如，在世界许多地方，当地饮用水质量差引发公共卫生问题。（课文原句）
Careless planning gave rise to countless difficulties once the project was under way. （议论文·管理）
The mysterious illness spreading through the town gave rise to widespread concern. （读后续写·公共危机）
The star's sudden absence from the stage gave rise to all kinds of speculation among the fans. （读后续写·悬念）
The proposal to charge for plastic bags gave rise to heated debate across the community. （议论文·公共政策）

collocations.phrase: give rise to a sense of ...
collocations.example: The unexpected praise from her teacher gave rise to a sense of pride she had never felt before. （读后续写·成长·情感）

collocations.phrase: give rise to public health problems
collocations.example: Polluted drinking water can quickly give rise to public health problems in crowded cities. （议论文·环境与健康）
A hastily written message may easily give rise to misunderstanding between friends. （应用文·人际提醒）

synonyms.example: A single act of kindness can lead to a chain of goodwill no one could have predicted. （读后续写·正能量）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、最口语,好坏结果均可,强调因果的'引向';give rise to 更书面、更正式,且多引出问题/情绪/现象等抽象事物

synonyms.example: Years of over-fishing have resulted in the near-collapse of the local fishing industry. （议论文·生态）
synonyms.usage: 强调'产生某种结果',后接名词或动名词;give rise to 强调'催生、成为源头',更含'从中生发'的意味

synonyms.example: It was one determined teacher who brought about a complete change in the failing school. （读后续写·变革）
synonyms.usage: 偏中性,常指'促成某种变化/结果',可用于积极改变;give rise to 更常带来问题或抽象现象

synonyms.example: A careless spark triggered a blaze that swept through the entire forest within hours. （读后续写·灾难）
synonyms.usage: 强调'突然触发',像扳机一样瞬间引爆,动态感强;give rise to 过程更平缓、渐进

advancedExpressions.expression: give rise to / lead to / result in / contribute to / bring about / cause（均接名词或动名词）
advancedExpressions.example: Heavy rain led to flooding. 大雨导致洪水。/ The mistake resulted in a serious accident. 这个失误造成了严重事故。/ Stress contributes to poor health. 压力是健康不佳的一个原因。/ The reform brought about great changes. 改革带来了巨大变化。/ 反向表达 result from 由……导致：The accident resulted from careless driving. 事故由粗心驾驶引起。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·氛围/情感生发
advancedExpressions.expression: the ... gave rise to a ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The faint sound of footsteps behind me gave rise to a fear that quickened my every step. （用抽象名词 fear/hope/warmth 作宾语,续写自然引出心理反应）

advancedExpressions.expression: the fact that ... has given rise to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The fact that our library closes so early has given rise to real difficulties for students who study after class. （建议信客观指出问题的正式句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is ... that gives rise to ..., not ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is inequality of opportunity, not a lack of talent, that gives rise to so much wasted human potential. （强调句 It is...that...+对比,凸显真正根源）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Dirty water causes health problems.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In many corners of the world where clean water remains a distant dream, the poor quality of what little people can drink gives rise to public health problems that quietly claim lives year after year. （议论文·全球健康）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: where 引导地点定语从句设背景 + what little people can drink 名词性从句 + give rise to 正式短语 + that 定语从句(quietly claim lives)延伸后果 + year after year 收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: The noise made me feel afraid.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A low, unfamiliar creak drifted up from the cellar, and at once it gave rise to a cold prickle of fear that crept slowly up the back of my neck. （读后续写·恐惧·感官）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 感官细节(low creak, cold prickle)+ give rise to 引出心理 + that 定语从句 + crept up the back of my neck 具象化恐惧的身体反应

classPractice.question: 在世界许多地方，当地饮用水质量差引发公共健康问题。（用 give rise to）
classPractice.answer: In many parts of the world, the poor quality of the local drinking water gives rise to public health problems.
classPractice.note: give rise to"引发，导致"，教材 Project 板块原句；主语中心词 quality 为单数，谓语用 gives。

classPractice.question: 每空一词，使上下两句意思相同：The proposal to charge for plastic bags led to heated debate across the community. → The proposal to charge for plastic bags ____ ____ ____ heated debate across the community.
classPractice.note: give rise to = lead to / result in / bring about"引发"；注意与原句时态一致，give 变过去式 gave。

classPractice.question: The star's sudden absence from the stage gave rise ____ all kinds of speculation among the fans.
classPractice.note: give rise to 中 to 是介词，后接名词/动名词；短语多引出 problems/concern/speculation 等抽象事物。

translation: adj. 更多的，更进一步的 | adv. 更远，进一步地 | vt. 促进，推进
original_sentence: To prevent further damage to water bodies, it is necessary to take some measures.
readingExamples: To prevent further damage to water bodies, it is necessary to take some measures.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. to a greater distance or degree; at or to a more distant point in space or time (comparative of 'far')
(2) adv. in addition; moreover (used to add another point)
(3) adj. more; additional (used before a noun to mean extra of the same kind)
(4) vt. to help something to progress, develop, or succeed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ① 更远（far 的比较级）；进一步
uncommonMeanings.example: We decided not to go any further. 我们决定不再往前走了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ② 更多的，附加的（further damage 课文词块；further information 更多信息；further education 继续教育）
uncommonMeanings.example: To prevent further damage to water bodies, it is necessary to take some measures. 为防止对水体的进一步破坏，有必要采取一些措施。（课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③ 促进，增进，推动【熟词僻义！】（further one's career/interests/cause）
uncommonMeanings.example: He worked hard to further his career. 他努力工作以推进自己的事业。/ Determined to further the cause of the poor village, the young teacher gave up a comfortable city job and never once looked back. （读后续写·奉献·理想）

posExamples.sentence: The deeper we ventured into the cave and the further the daylight fell behind us, the louder my own heartbeat seemed to pound in the suffocating dark. （读后续写·探险·紧张）
I am writing to request further information about the summer volunteer programme, as the notice on the board left several important questions unanswered. （应用文·询问信）
A truly great education should not merely fill young minds with facts, but further their curiosity, their courage, and their capacity to think for themselves. （议论文·教育本质）
To prevent further damage to our rivers, it is essential that we act without delay; further, every citizen must see this as a shared duty rather than someone else's task. （议论文·环境行动）

idioms.idiom: nothing could be further from the truth
idioms.translation: 完全不是那么回事;大错特错
idioms.example: People assumed the quiet boy was proud and cold, but nothing could be further from the truth — he was simply too shy to speak. （读后续写·消除误解）

idioms.translation: 更进一步;更起作用;走得更远
idioms.example: A little kindness goes a long way, but genuine understanding goes further still. （议论文·人际）
Without further ado, let me announce the winner of this year's speech contest. （应用文·主持词）

collocations.example: For further details about the trip, please contact the office before Friday. （应用文·通知）

collocations.translation: 进一步的破坏 / 伤害
collocations.example: Wrapping the injured bird gently, she did her best to prevent any further harm. （读后续写·善良）
Immediate action is needed to prevent further pollution of the bay. （议论文·环保）
After graduation, she went abroad for further study in marine biology. （读后续写·追梦）

collocations.translation: 进一步研究 / 深入探讨某事
collocations.example: The strange marks on the door puzzled me, and I resolved to look into the matter further. （读后续写·探究）

collocations.translation: 促进某人的事业 / 利益 / 事业理想
collocations.example: He never used friendships merely to further his own career. （议论文·品格）

collocations.translation: 在另行通知前;直到另行通知
collocations.example: The swimming pool will remain closed until further notice due to repairs. （应用文·公告）

collocations.translation: 把某事进一步推进 / 升级处理
collocations.example: If the noise continues, I am afraid we shall have to take the matter further. （应用文·投诉信）
Having explored every corner of the town, the curious children now longed to travel further afield. （读后续写·好奇心）

synonyms.translation: 更远（仅指具体空间距离）
synonyms.example: The station is farther than I thought. 车站比我想的更远。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：表具体空间距离“更远”时 farther/further 皆可（walk farther/further）；表抽象的“进一步、更多、附加”（further information / further education / discuss it further）只能用 further；further 还可作动词“促进”（further one's career），farther 无此用法

synonyms.example: The plan is costly; moreover, it may not solve the problem at all. （议论文·递进论证）
synonyms.usage: 作副词,纯粹用于书面'补充观点',比 further(在此义)更正式;不能表'更远/额外的'

synonyms.example: The teacher offered additional support to any student struggling with the topic. （应用文·帮助）
synonyms.usage: 只作形容词表'额外的',与 further 作形容词时(further information)义近;但 further 更强调'在原有基础上再多一些'

synonyms.example: The festival was designed to promote friendship between the two schools. （应用文·活动介绍）
synonyms.usage: 作动词与 further(vt.)近义,但 promote 更常用、更口语,可指'宣传/晋升';further 作动词书面色彩浓,多搭配 cause/career/interests

synonyms.example: Their research greatly advanced our understanding of the disease. （议论文·科学）
synonyms.usage: 与 further(vt.)近义,强调'向前推进';advance 还可作名词/表'前进',用法更广

advancedExpressions.expression: furthermore / moreover / besides / what's more / in addition（此外，而且）
advancedExpressions.example: The plan is practical; furthermore, it costs little. 这个方案切实可行，而且花费很少。/ Moreover, exercise improves mood. 此外，运动能改善情绪。/ Besides, it is too late to change now. 再说，现在改也来不及了。/ What's more, the tickets are free. 更棒的是，门票免费。/ In addition, we offer free delivery. 另外，我们提供免费送货。

advancedExpressions.expression: the further ..., the + 比较级 ...
advancedExpressions.example: The further I walked into the forest, the more certain I became that I was no longer alone. （'the + 比较级...the + 比较级'双重比较,续写层层递进、蓄势）

advancedExpressions.expression: should you require any further ..., please ...
advancedExpressions.example: Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me at any time. （倒装虚拟条件句,书信客套结尾的高级表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: to prevent further ..., it is high time that we ...
advancedExpressions.example: To prevent further destruction of our planet, it is high time that we moved from empty talk to concrete action. （目的状语开头+it is high time虚拟语气,增强号召力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I walked further and felt more scared.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With every further step I took into that yawning darkness, an icy dread tightened its grip on me, until my legs seemed to move of their own accord, unwilling to carry me one inch closer. （读后续写·恐惧·环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With every further step 介词短语递进 + yawning darkness 拟人化环境 + tighten its grip 拟人 + until 引导结果 + move of their own accord 具象化失控感

sentenceUpgrade.original: We must stop more damage to the water.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If we are to prevent any further damage to the waters that sustain us, it is imperative that swift and united action be taken before the wounds we have inflicted grow beyond all healing. （议论文·环境呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If we are to do... 目的性条件句 + it is imperative that + 虚拟语气(be taken)+ the waters that sustain us 定语从句拟人 + beyond all healing 比喻收束升华

classPractice.question: My home is a bit ____ (farther / further) from the school than yours — it takes me half an hour longer to walk.
classPractice.note: 表实际空间距离"更远"时 farther 与 further 均正确(传统考法偏向 farther)；核心区别在于：farther 只能指距离，不能表抽象的"进一步"，而 further 两义皆可。

classPractice.question: For ____ (farther / further) details about the volunteer programme, please contact the office before Friday.
classPractice.note: 表抽象的"更多的，进一步的"(further information/details/study)只能用 further，不能用 farther——距离用 farther，程度/抽象用 further。

classPractice.question: 为防止对水体的进一步破坏，有必要采取一些措施。To prevent ____ ____ (进一步的破坏) to water bodies, it is necessary to take some measures.
classPractice.note: further 作形容词"进一步的"；prevent further damage/harm 为教材原句搭配。

classPractice.question: 他从不单纯利用友谊来推进自己的事业。He never used friendships merely to ____ (促进，推进) his own career.
classPractice.note: further 还可作及物动词"促进，推动"，常搭配 one's career/cause/interests，为熟词生义考点。
